summary: The patch revokes every hub session for the affected account on password create, replacement, clear, email-plus-password attachment, and passkey removal, and it rotates the initiating session on self-service password changes and passkey removal. The added regression creates two pre-change sessions and verifies both return 401 after a password change while the rotated session returns 200.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts adds revokeHubSessionsForUser and calls it after successful savePasswordCredential, clearPasswordCredential, attachEmailAndPassword, and removePasskey operations.

src/passport.ts rotates the initiating session with a new hub cookie after passkey removal and after an administrator changes or clears their own password; the self-service password register path returns hubLoginResponse, which creates a fresh session after revocation.
src/handler_test.ts adds a regression with two sessions proving both pre-change tokens fail after the password change while the rotated token remains valid.
Administrative password changes for another account revoke that account sessions without disturbing the administrator session, matching the initiating-browser requirement.
